traps: Systemwide sales ($37 billion) are not revenues; consolidated revenues were $7,099 million because franchised sales are not recorded as revenues.
Reported vs constant currency: revenues up 4% (2% cc), Systemwide sales up 5% (4% cc), operating income up 3% (2% cc), diluted EPS up 6% (5% cc).
GAAP diluted EPS is $3.32; the $3.38 figure is non-GAAP, excluding $0.06 per share of current year charges.
Quarter vs six months: six-month revenues $13,616 million, GAAP EPS $6.10, non-GAAP EPS $6.21, and charges $99 million or $0.11 per share.
Operating income rose 3% as reported; the 4% figure excludes current and prior year charges.
The $40 billion loyalty figure is a trailing-twelve-month aggregate across 70 markets, not quarterly sales.
Comparable sales tables show current and prior year side by side: 1.3 total and 0.8 U.S. this quarter vs 3.8 and 2.5 a year ago.
Segment vs total: U.S. 0.8%, International Operated Markets 1.5%, International Developmental Licensed Markets 1.9%, total 1.3%.

U.S. comparable sales were driven by positive check growth, partly offset by negative comparable guest counts; abroad, France partly offset IOM and negative comparable sales in China partly offset IDL.
The release gives no guidance, no buyback or dividend figures, and no cash flow or balance sheet figures; a brief must not invent them.
